text: Similar segments of circles on equal straight-lines are equal to one another. For let $AEB$ and $CFD$ be similar segments of circles on the equal straight-lines $AB$ and $CD$ (respectively). I say that segment $AEB$ is equal to segment $CFD$.

For if the segment $AEB$ is applied to the segment $CFD$, and point $A$ is placed on (point) $C$, and the straight-line $AB$ on $CD$, (then) point $B$ will also coincide with point $D$, on account of $AB$ being equal to $CD$.
assertion: B coincides with D (when AEB is applied to CFD with A on C and AB on CD, because AB equals CD)

spans.label: assumption
spans.text: the segment $AEB$ is applied to the segment $CFD$, and point $A$ is placed on (point) $C$, and the straight-line $AB$ on $CD$

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: point $B$ will also coincide with point $D$

text: And if $AB$ coincides with $CD$, (then) the segment $AEB$ will also coincide with $CFD$.
assertion: segment AEB coincides with CFD (given AB coincides with CD)

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: the segment $AEB$ will also coincide with $CFD$

text: For if the straight-line $AB$ coincides with $CD$, and the segment $AEB$ does not coincide with $CFD$, (then) it will surely either fall inside it, outside (it),$^\dag$ or it will miss like $CGD$ (in the figure),
assertion: AEB either falls inside CFD, outside it, or misses like CGD

frame.supposition: the segment $AEB$ does not coincide with $CFD$

spans.label: assumption
spans.text: the segment $AEB$ does not coincide with $CFD$

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: it will surely either fall inside it, outside (it),$^\dag$ or it will miss like $CGD$ (in the figure)

text: and a circle (will) cut (another) circle at more than two points.
assertion: a circle cuts another circle at more than two points

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: a circle (will) cut (another) circle at more than two points

text: Thus, if the straight-line $AB$ is applied to $CD$, the segment $AEB$ cannot not also coincide with $CFD$.
assertion: segment AEB must coincide with CFD (cannot not coincide)

frame.closes: the segment $AEB$ does not coincide with $CFD$

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: the segment $AEB$ cannot not also coincide with $CFD$

text: and will be equal to it [C.N.~4].
Thus, similar segments of circles on equal straight-lines are equal to one another. (Which is) the very thing it was required to show.
